references.text: Concerns the Jubilee year and the return of ancestral property, which forms the basis for valuing consecrated land.
Deals with the redemption of ancestral properties and the rules for how land can be bought back.
Continues the regulations on valuing consecrated land based on the Jubilee year.
Everything devoted to the Lord in Israel shall belong to the priests, relating to the sanctification of property.
Mentions the homer as a unit of measure, the same unit used in assessing seed grain.
Refers to the sanctuary shekel as the standard weight, the same shekel used in valuation.
Concerns the redemption of ancestral land and the family's right to buy back property.
